## Line insertion

::: magic-move

```r
a <- 1
b <- 2
d <- 4
```

```r
a <- 1
b <- 2
c <- 3
d <- 4
```

:::

## Token rename

::: magic-move

```r
total <- sum(values)
mean_val <- total / length(values)
print(mean_val)
```

```r
grand_total <- sum(values)
mean_val <- grand_total / length(values)
print(mean_val)
```

:::

## Pipe extraction

::: magic-move

```r

```

```

```

## Large block small diff

::: magic-move

```r
process_data <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(value))
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(value = value * 1)
  df <- df %>%
    group_by(category) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(value))
  df <- df %>%
    arrange(desc(total))
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number())
  return(df)
}
```

```r
process_data <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(value))
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(value = value * 100)
  df <- df %>%
    group_by(category) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(value))
  df <- df %>%
    arrange(desc(total))
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number())
  return(df)
}
```

:::
